method: Pipeline v2: the deck from the evidence (September's review, or the card with four photo years and the laser where they disagree), the place on it from the card, measured as the shared tracer measures. Decks never move.

kept.5: Every colour on hole 5, decks and fairway alike, reads 11 to 16 m longer than its card. The decks stand in the card's order and each holds one colour, so the tees are not what is long: the drawn hole line (five legs round the dogleg) is longer than the line the club measured. Moving the marks forward would put them off their decks; the line is the fault, and the walkthrough keeps it.
kept.14: Every colour on hole 14 reads 15 to 20 m longer than its card. The three decks stand in the card's order (Vit/Gul, Blå, Röd) on all four photo years; the drawn line turns the dogleg square (177 m south, then two bends), where the club's line cuts the corner. The tees stand; the line is the fault, and the walkthrough keeps it.

unresolved.8:Vit: Under the conifer canopy north of deck 1 on all four photo years; no deck shows, and the laser was not read for a platform there tonight.
unresolved.8:Gul: Under the conifer canopy north of deck 1 on all four photo years; no deck shows, and the laser was not read for a platform there tonight.
unresolved.9:Vit: No deck shows 143 m out on any photo year: the reviewed deck 1 ends at 137 m, and the ground behind it is under crowns.

marks.why: Hole 1 was lengthened between the 2020 and 2023 cards (Vit 355 to 386), after the club's 2021 plan to move the back tees. Deck 1, the isolated deck at the north-east spur, is forest on the 2019 photo, felled ground on 2021-04-14, and a mown deck with its own path on 2023-05-11 and 2025-04-24; it is the only ground 386 m out (379-394 m). The laser of 2021-03-20 shows it not level (4.4%, 0.22 m off a plane): built after the flight. September's candidate was this deck; the card settles the colour.

The long strip east of the path (deck 2) reaches 328-348 m: its north end is Gul's 350 m and its south end Blå's 319, 31 m apart on the card and 30 m along the strip. September left Gul on the path, where no deck is.
The south end of deck 2, the strip that holds Gul at its north end. The card puts Blå 9 m further forward than the strip reaches; deck 3 (Röd, 262-275 m) is 50 m on.
